item.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer announced, coming 2026
item.description: To quote a certain Skywalker: "Now this is pod racing!" (almost). Read more

item.title: Eagerly-awaited Chinese action game Phantom Blade Zero finally gets a release date (and yes, it's still a PS5 console exclusive)
item.description: Chinese action game Phantom Blade Zero finally has a worldwide release date: 9th September 2026. Read more

item.title: Total War: Warhammer 40,000 is finally, actually real, coming to Xbox, PlayStation and PC - but has no release date
item.description: It's finally official: we're getting a Total War: Warhammer 40,000 game. It's finally been announced at The Game Awards 2025. Read more

item.title: Clair Obscur is game of the year, but what about everything else? Here are the winners of the 2025 Game Awards
item.description: The annual Geoffs are over for another year, leaving a massive Clair Obscur-shaped celebration in its wake. Not unexpectedly, developer Sandfall Interactive's highly acclaimed RPG was crowned Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2025, but what about everything else? Let's find out! Read more

item.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33's expansion is available right now, adding a photo mode and vibrant new world
item.description: The previously revealed expansion to Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is available right now, as announced at tonight's The Game Awards. Read more

item.title: Think of a condensed Cyberpunk 2077 and you're somewhere near No Law, a new open-world shooter RPG from the makers of The Ascent
item.description: Neon Giant, Swedish developer of cyberpunk shooter-RPG The Ascent, has unveiled its new game No Law at The Game Awards 2025. The game is in development for PC, PS5 and Xbox S/X, and will be published by South Korean company Krafton. There's currently no release date. Read more

item.title: The Game Awards' big reveal this year was for a shooter from the creatives behind Apex Legends and Titanfall, and it looked... fine?
item.description: The Game Awards 2025 have come and gone, with Clair Obscur coming away with the coveted GOTY accolade. But, among the awards at the awards show, there was also a very generous smattering of trailers and reveals. And rounding out those trailers and reveals as part of Geoff's big finale was Highguard. Read more

item.title: "We'll have more stuff next year" After being somewhat absent from The Game Awards, Xbox boss teases a Dev Direct for January 2026
item.description: The Game Awards has only just wrapped, but already we've already got another (vague) date in our calendars: January 2026. Per an interview with Microsoft’s president of game content and studios, Matt Booty, in Variety, Xbox will be hosting one of its Dev Direct streams in January. Read more

item.title: Mega Man's finally making a comeback, but his first big game in years is still a while away
item.description: Mega Man! It turns out Capcom hasn't forgotten about the blue robo-dude with the 'tude - last seen in his own mainline game seven years ago - after all. The publisher has unveiled a brand-new entry in its beloved action-platformer series, but you'll need to be patient as it's still a while away from release. Read more

item.title: "The scripts are incredible, and very funny" - Sigourney Weaver confirms she will play Wallace in live-action Tomb Raider series
item.description: Sigourney Weaver has confirmed she has accepted a role in Amazon's upcoming Tomb Raider series from Phoebe Waller-Bridge. Read more
